name: kneeling abdominal stretch
description: A kneeling backbend that opens the front of the torso.
instructions: Kneel with your knees hip width apart and place your hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lean back until the abdominal muscles stretch.
Tuck your chin a little and avoid dropping your head back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
